title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (July, 2025)
summary: This post documents the July 2025 cumulative updates for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central across multiple versions (BC26, BC25, BC24), including cloud and on-premises releases with their build numbers and support lifecycle information.
key_points: BC26 CU03 released with platform and application builds for both cloud SaaS and on-premises environments
BC25 wave 2 introduces more flexible environment update management with extended major update windows and optional minor updates
Multiple versions supported simultaneously with defined support dates: BC26 ends Oct 13 2026, BC25 ends Apr 4 2026, BC24 ends Oct 7 2025
On-premises versions follow Modern Lifecycle Policy with continuing support status from October 2019 onwards

quotes.text: Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows BC25 introduces significant changes to how organizations control update schedules with extended timelines and optional updates

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies which lifecycle policy applies to on-premises deployments, important for planning support and upgrades
